concerns.text: Potential NullPointerException in TaskService: if gitHubService.getPrStatus(task.getGithubPrNumber()) returns null, calling prStatus.getState() or prStatus.isMerged() will crash. A null check on prStatus should be added to handle API failures or missing PRs gracefully.

Hardcoded system clock: calling LocalDateTime.now() directly in updateTaskStatus and syncTaskStatusesWithGitHub makes it difficult to test time-dependent logic deterministically. Injecting a java.time.Clock instance or standard temporal provider is recommended.
